q: Almost all transition metals are good at conducting both heat and ____, making them useful for a variety of applications.
e: Almost all transition metals are good at conducting both heat and electricity, making them useful for a variety of applications. Transition metals often show variable oxidation states, coloured ions, and catalytic behaviour.

q: Titanium is an integral part of modern construction because it is highly ____, strong, and lightweight.
e: Titanium is an integral part of modern construction because it is highly corrosion-resistant, strong, and lightweight. Corrosion-resistant is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Iron is usually too ____ to be used as metal alone.
e: Iron is usually too soft to be used as metal alone. Soft is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Iron is usually mixed with small amounts of other elements to make harder alloy steels with greater ____ strength.
e: Iron is usually mixed with small amounts of other elements to make harder alloy steels with greater tensile strength. An alloy is a mixture of metals, often harder or more corrosion-resistant than the pure metal.

q: Manganese is mainly used in alloys, such as ____.
e: Manganese is mainly used in alloys, such as steel. Steel is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Steel contains about 1% manganese to increase the strength and also improve workability and ____.
e: Steel contains about 1% manganese to increase the strength and also improve workability and resistance. Resistance is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Manganese steel is extremely strong and is used for ____ tracks.
e: Manganese steel is extremely strong and is used for railway tracks. Railway is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Vanadium(V) oxide ($V_2O_5$) is used as a catalyst in the ceramics industry, and as a ____ in the printing and dyeing of fabrics.
e: Vanadium(V) oxide (V2O5) is used as a catalyst in the ceramics industry, and as a mordant in the printing and dyeing of fabrics. A catalyst speeds or slows a reaction by changing the path, but it is not used up in the overall equation.

q: Chromium has many industrial uses due to its toughness and resistance to heat and ____.
e: Chromium has many industrial uses due to its toughness and resistance to heat and corrosion. Corrosion is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Chromium is widely used for manufacturing ____ steel.
e: Chromium is widely used for manufacturing stainless steel. Stainless is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Chromium is mainly used in electroplating, tanning, printing, dyeing, catalysts, oxidants, matches, and metal corrosion ____.
e: Chromium is mainly used in electroplating, tanning, printing, dyeing, catalysts, oxidants, matches, and metal corrosion inhibitors. Inhibitors is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Manganese is used as a catalyst to reduce the ____ rating in gasoline.
e: Manganese is used as a catalyst to reduce the octane rating in gasoline. A catalyst speeds or slows a reaction by changing the path, but it is not used up in the overall equation.

q: Cobalt ion has brilliant ____ colour used as paint, ink, and pigments.
e: Cobalt ion has brilliant blue colour used as paint, ink, and pigments. Blue is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Nickel is used for anti-corrosion coating, and nickel ____.
e: Nickel is used for anti-corrosion coating, and nickel plating. Plating is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Copper is a good conductor of electricity and it is used for electrical wire, circuit boards, water ____, and industrial machinery.
e: Copper is a good conductor of electricity and it is used for electrical wire, circuit boards, water pipes, and industrial machinery. Pipes is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Iron is used to treat and prevent ____.
e: Iron is used to treat and prevent anemia. Anemia is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Copper has been used to treat Wilson's disease and ____ disease.
e: Copper has been used to treat Wilson's disease and Menkes disease. Menkes is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The surgical instruments are made of transition metals such as stainless steel, cobalt-chrome alloys, ____ and its alloys.
e: The surgical instruments are made of transition metals such as stainless steel, cobalt-chrome alloys, titanium and its alloys. Transition metals often show variable oxidation states, coloured ions, and catalytic behaviour.

q: Titanium surgical instruments offer several advantages over stainless steel instruments, such as being lightweight, durable, and ____.
e: Titanium surgical instruments offer several advantages over stainless steel instruments, such as being lightweight, durable, and corrosion-resistant. Corrosion-resistant is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Titanium has been used mostly for fabricating dental ____.
e: Titanium has been used mostly for fabricating dental implants. Implants is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.
